title: A 13th sign just crashed the photo.
caption: A glittery newcomer crashes the zodiac's group photo and calls itself the 13th sign. Saturn checks the facts: twelve seats, counted twice. Charm isn't the same as character. Who in your life is all sparkle, no substance?
